format_note: Rendering GeoJSON has rounded coordinates (6 decimal places); official source archive URLs, byte sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded below.
datum: NAD83 / geographic degrees; browser mapping uses lon/lat coordinates
processing: Rendering geometry is produced directly from Census shapefiles; no projection shifting or decorative edits. Representative interior points are calculated for labels/search.
coverage: All supplied Census geographies, including territories, DC, CDPs and micro areas.
display_note: Alaska and Hawaii use western insets; Puerto Rico uses a Gulf inset. Raw geographic coordinates are preserved in bundled data. All Census places participate in adaptive city labeling.
